RagShortTexts: The Archbishop of Mainz reigned as Primate of Germany and senior Imperial Elector,.

Variants.Content: Mainz commanded the confluence of the Main and Rhine rivers. Holding the dignity of Primate of Germany, its Prince-Archbishop served as Arch-Chancellor of the Holy Roman Empire, possessing the constitutional monopoly to summon electors for imperial conclaves.
Heavily fortified red sandstone walls guarded strategic toll barriers that enriched the archiepiscopal treasury during interregnum power struggles.
